text.en: Roosters crow! Up in the morning sky shines a warm, round ball of light.
text.zhs: 公鸡喔喔叫！清晨的天空上，挂着一轮暖洋洋的圆太阳。

text.en: Carving a round circle on hard bone with a knife was tricky, so carvers made an outline with a bright mark in the middle.
text.zhs: 拿小刀在坚硬的骨头上刻圆圈可不容易，于是刻字的人刻出边框，中间加上代表光芒的一笔。

text.en: That bright sky-window is 日, the sun — and also a whole day from sunrise to sunset!
text.zhs: 这扇装满阳光的小窗户就是“日”——既是太阳，也代表从早到晚的一整天！

text.en: Look out at the horizon: three rocky peaks stand shoulder to shoulder, with the tallest peak right in the middle.

text.en: How do you draw a whole forest without spending all afternoon drawing trees? Put two trees side by side!
text.zhs: 要想画出一片树林，难道要画上一整天吗？聪明的人把两棵树并排画在一起！

text.en: Carvers placed one 木 next to another 木: two trunks, two canopies, sharing the same patch of earth.
text.zhs: 刻字的人把两个“木”并排放在一起：两根树干、两丛枝丫，肩并肩长在同一片土地上。

text.en: Notice how the left tree tucks its right root in politely so the two trees don’t bump into each other!
text.zhs: 仔细看：左边那棵树礼貌地把右边的一捺收成了一点，这样两棵树就不会挤在一起啦！

text.en: One tree is 木, two trees make 林 (woods), and three trees stacked together make 森 (deep forest)!

text.zht: 獨木不成林：一棵樹是「木」，兩棵樹是「林」，三棵樹疊在一起就是大森林的「森」！

text.en: A single tree stands by the riverbank: green branches reaching up for sunlight, and roots gripping the soil underground.
text.zhs: 河岸边立着一棵树：树枝向上迎着阳光，树根向下紧紧抓住泥土。
text.zht: 河岸邊立著一棵樹：樹枝向上迎著陽光，樹根向下緊緊抓住泥土。

text.en: Even without leaves, the carved shape is unmistakable: a trunk in the middle, two branches curving up, and two roots curving down.
text.zhs: 就算不画树叶，刻出来的样子也一目了然：中间是树干，上面两根分叉是树枝，下面两根分叉是树根。

text.en: Three thousand years ago, wild elephants roamed the Yellow River valley! Their most famous feature was that long, curling trunk.
text.zhs: 三千年前，黄河流域还生活着野生大象！大象最醒目的标志，就是那根又长又弯的鼻子。

text.en: Put 女 (mother) and 子 (child) right next to each other and what word do they make? 好 — good and happy!

text.en: Why didn’t carvers draw a full round moon? Because a round circle already belonged to 日, the sun! Drawing a crescent made 月 unmistakable.
text.zhs: 为什么古人不把月亮画成圆圆的满月呢？因为圆圈已经给了太阳“日”！画成弯弯的月牙，一眼就能认出“月”。
